answer: Sybil resistance: rotating pairwise co-witness re-minting. Voting weight expires each epoch; a prior-block VRF assigns two random co-signers attesting it is one live operator, a relayed lantern. Re-minting burns 1.5 units plus 0.001 per active identity, so cost grows linearly in n: 1000 clones pay 1000x. Validators reject ballots lacking both VRF-assigned co-signatures at epoch dawn, slashing co-signers on proven duplicates. Clones cannot parallelize: pairing is unpredictable, bound to a non-transferable key whose tenure resets on rekeying, a glacier no split can thaw.
